digest.component_or_area: code review gate — impact model redesign (code-v3 to code-v4)
propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards prod_impact and trigger_likelihood for maint-lane findings, causing test-sufficiency findings to score ~0.30 and remain below the 0.95 advisory threshold.

A contract declaring 'stale>0 allowed (exit 0)' co-shipped with a test asserting 'stale=0' (bug dystopian-bardlike-basil) was not blocked because the antipattern and serious-maint severity binary forbids_contract_allowed_state did not exist.
Code-v4 reintroduces prod_impact multipliers into maint-lane scoring, splits consequence and debt lanes with different dampening rules, and restricts reversibility floor to consequence lanes only.
New antipattern contract-contradicting-assertion must be added to code-review-tests.md with verbatim evidence and guards (stated deliberate tightening and pure-function exact-value asserts excluded).
Tests lane must flip from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 with code-v4; replay on 1881 code-v3 sidecars shows 42→99 changes blocked (3.4%→8.0%), zero demotions, no docs/cosmetic entries.
Eight consumer test files and two evaluation specs must be updated to pin code-v4 version, new blocking-set members, new binary emission logic, and re-targeted churn/floor premises.
